item.title: bewhere.app
item.description: A free web app for event staff scheduling. Plan which people work at which location and when, spot coverage gaps and share personal schedules with your festival, conference or venue team.

item.title: Circlapse
item.description: A small Python tool born from my interest in photography: it detects circles and ellipses in photos (like manhole covers), centers them and crops all images to the same scale, so that a series of pictures can be turned into a smooth time-lapse-like animation.
